summary: Three independent runs exercised the external frontend and backend. Core inquiry validation, persistence, CORS, endpoint wiring, and the complete success flow passed after provider cooldown, including field clearing and both email proxy calls returning 202. The merged issues are that transient Resend 429 throttling can produce 502/failed inquiries, the API can report success and email_status=sent when customer confirmation delivery fails, whitespace-only wishes bypass backend validation, the frontend failure fallback still names the rejected mailbox, and visible header CTA/menu controls are inert.

critical.title: Email-provider rate limiting causes unreliable inquiry delivery
critical.steps_to_reproduce: Submit valid inquiries with product=Handyhülle, a non-empty wish, and email=delivered@resend.dev while the managed email integration is receiving concurrent requests or is rate-limited; inspect the response and backend logs.
critical.expected: The inquiry should reliably return HTTP 200 with status=success and email_status=sent, or transient 429 responses should be retried/queued safely with a controlled, accurate failure state.
critical.actual: The managed Resend proxy returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests for owner and/or confirmation sends. Valid submissions returned HTTP 502 and were persisted with email_status=failed; another request returned HTTP 200 with confirmation_sent=false while the customer send was rate-limited.
critical.impact: The original customer-visible 'Senden fehlgeschlagen' problem remains reproducible during provider throttling, and there is no retry/backoff or durable delivery recovery.

critical.title: API reports success when customer confirmation delivery fails
critical.steps_to_reproduce: Submit valid inquiry data when the owner email request receives 202 but the subsequent customer confirmation request receives 429 or another failure; inspect the response and persisted inquiry.
critical.expected: The confirmation should be retried/queued, or the API should return an explicit partial-delivery state that the frontend can display; it must not claim that confirmation was sent or mark the complete inquiry as sent.
critical.actual: The route returns HTTP 200 with status=success and confirmation_sent=false when owner_sent=true, while the inquiry can be persisted with email_status=sent. The frontend displays the success alert after any HTTP 200 and therefore says a confirmation was sent.
critical.impact: The owner may receive the inquiry while the customer receives no confirmation and is incorrectly told that it was sent.

minor.title: Whitespace-only wishes pass backend validation
minor.steps_to_reproduce: POST /api/inquiries with a valid product, email=delivered@resend.dev, and wish="   ".
minor.expected: HTTP 422 because the wish is semantically empty, matching the frontend trim-based gate.
minor.actual: Pydantic min_length=1 accepts whitespace-only input, so it proceeds to persistence and email delivery.
minor.impact: Direct API clients can create empty inquiries and consume email-provider quota.

ui_bugs.title: Header call-to-action and menu controls are inert
ui_bugs.location: Page header buttons data-testid=header-cta-button and data-testid=menu-button
ui_bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Load the homepage and click the 'Jetzt anfragen' CTA and the hamburger 'Menü' button.
ui_bugs.expected: The CTA should focus or scroll to the inquiry form, and the menu button should open navigation or these controls should not be presented as interactive buttons.
ui_bugs.actual: Both styled buttons accept clicks but produce no navigation, focus, menu, or other visible state change.
ui_bugs.impact: Visible primary navigation controls appear broken and do not provide the expected shortcut/navigation behavior.

integration_issues.title: Failure fallback still directs users to the rejected mailbox
integration_issues.steps_to_reproduce: Trigger a network, 5xx, or provider failure during form submission, such as the observed external 502 caused by the email proxy 429, and inspect the error alert text.
integration_issues.expected: The fallback should reference the configured owner inbox manuel.neff@gmail.com or avoid displaying a hardcoded mailbox.
integration_issues.actual: The fallback text directs users to anfrage@gravurwerkschweiz.ch, the rejected/undeliverable destination from the incident context. This stale text is reached when external/proxy failures do not provide a usable detail field.
integration_issues.impact: Users encountering the exact failure state are directed to the same unusable address that caused the original issue, risking lost inquiries.

action_items: Add retry/backoff or durable queue handling for transient email-provider 429 responses and keep inquiry/email status accurate.
Do not return a fully successful inquiry or email_status=sent when customer confirmation delivery fails; expose an accurate partial-failure state to the frontend.
Reject whitespace-only wishes in backend validation.
Replace the stale rejected mailbox in the frontend failure fallback.
Implement the visible header CTA and menu interactions or remove their interactive presentation.
